title: Infrastructure Cloud LoadBalancer Entity
description: Common properties shared by all cloud load balancer services (AWS ALB, GCP Cloud Load Balancing, Azure LB).

type.description: Load balancer type: L7 (application) vs L4 (network).

scheme.description: Whether the load balancer is publicly accessible or internal only.

port.description: Port number the listener accepts traffic on.

target_port.description: Port on the backend target to forward traffic to.

certificate.description: TLS/SSL certificate identifier for HTTPS listeners.

health_check.description: Health check configuration for backend targets.

path.description: HTTP path for health check requests.

port.description: Port to use for health checks.

threshold.description: Number of consecutive checks before marking healthy/unhealthy.
